title: Search Insert Position
statement: Given a sorted array of distinct integers, return the index of `target` if it exists. Otherwise return the index where it would be inserted to keep the array sorted.
hints: This is lower bound: the first index whose value is greater than or equal to target.
Keep the invariant that the answer lies in [lo, hi].
When the loop ends, lo is the insertion point, even if it equals n.

approaches.name: Linear scan
approaches.explanation: Stop at the first value that is not smaller than target.

approaches.name: Lower-bound binary search
approaches.explanation: Half-open or closed search for the first nums[i] >= target.

editorial: Use a half-open interval [lo, hi). If nums[mid] < target, the insertion point is after mid. Otherwise it is at mid or before. When lo == hi the interval is empty and lo is the first position that is not strictly smaller than target.
